sections.heading: Repair or New Roof? The 25% Rule, Full Roof Replacement, and Metal Roofing vs. Membranes

runs.v: What is the 25% rule for roofing? In New Jersey it marks the permit line for commercial, multi-family, and attached buildings, where repairing more than 25% of the roof area in 12 months needs a permit. Many roofers also use it as a planning rule: once damage covers more than about a quarter of the roof, a new roof usually costs less over time than repeated roof repair. What type of roof is best for commercial buildings? For flat roofs, single-ply membranes such as TPO and EPDM or a modified-bitumen system; for sloped commercial buildings, metal roofing, which trades a higher first cost for a long service life. The right choice depends on the building, the budget, and how long the owner plans to hold it.
